name: Autocomplete
description:
Free text with suggestions as you type: search boxes, hostnames, paths. Choosing a
suggestion fills the text; anything else may be typed. Suggestions come from a static
list or an async source and use the same rows as Select and Combobox.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ options, source, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, onPick, fill, placeholder, size, width, icon, empty, footer, disabled, readOnly, required, invalid, name, id, onBlur, className, ref, ...aria }: AutocompleteProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: empty
props.description: Text for the empty row (only while a source has answered). Default: none.

props.name: fill
props.description: What choosing a suggestion puts in the field: its label (default) or its value.

props.name: footer
props.description: A quiet line at the foot of the suggestions: a data source's attribution.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid. Pair it with an accessible validation message.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when blur occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onPick
props.description: Called when a suggestion is chosen, with the option.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when value change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: options
props.description: Static suggestions, filtered as you type.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: source
props.description: Or suggestions searched on a server as you type.

props.name: value
props.description: The text. Not limited to the suggestions.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short, medium or full (default).
